prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic luxury-resort lifestyle portrait with warm golden-hour light, natural texture, and a relaxed summer atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with long straight hair, wearing a pink sequin camisole top and light green skirt. She holds a small silver digital camera with a colorful beaded wrist strap and laughs naturally while seated on an outdoor lounge sofa.
prompt.composition_elements: Place the subject on a lounge sofa in a tropical setting with lush green plants and palms behind her. In the foreground, include a marble table with a berry cheesecake slice and a pink cocktail with lime garnish. Use a relaxed seated composition, shallow depth of field, and clear product/prop separation.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunlight illuminates hair and skin with soft natural warmth, gentle shadows, realistic proportions, luxury resort mood, natural unretouched texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-detail image, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, natural perspective, realistic sequin sparkle, marble, dessert, cocktail, camera, and foliage texture, social-media-ready vertical portrait.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic image of an adult blonde woman with long straight hair sitting on an outdoor lounge sofa in a tropical setting, holding a small silver digital camera with a colorful beaded wrist strap. She wears a pink sequin camisole top and light green skirt, laughing naturally in golden-hour sunlight that illuminates her skin and hair. Lush green tropical plants and palm trees fill the background. In the foreground, a marble table holds a slice of berry cheesecake and a pink cocktail with lime garnish. Relaxed summer atmosphere, luxury resort aesthetic, highly detailed natural skin texture, realistic proportions, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition.
